features.title: Features · {project}

download.title: Get started · {project}
download.description: Download or clone the source from main. Run these steps from the toolkit root with Node.js 22 or newer and Git.

community.title: Community · {project}

ui.download: Read the install guide on GitHub

title: Write project docs and check release files
description: Use the Skill in a repository to draft a README, a pull request or release notes in the project's style. The local CLI can check project configuration, Git tags and release file hashes.
hero.primary_action: Read the install guide on GitHub

items.title: Check your environment
items.description: Run node bin/pwf.mjs doctor from the toolkit root to see the Node.js and Git versions.

items.title: Install and invoke the Skill
items.description: Open docs/getting-started.md in your checkout for installation steps. Then call $tangyixiao-workflow in the target repository.

groups.title: Draft a README or pull request
groups.description: Call $tangyixiao-workflow in the target repository. Ask it to use the contribution guide, PR template and your changes to draft a pull request.
groups.detail: You can use the Skill without running adopt. It can also draft release notes for the people who use the project.

groups.title: Check configuration and release files
groups.description: Run adopt to preview changes. Once applied, use check to verify the project configuration and the managed section of AGENTS.
groups.detail: Before a release, use release-check to verify the candidate version, Git tag and SHA-256 hashes of the declared files offline.

steps.title: Check your environment
steps.description: Run node bin/pwf.mjs doctor. Look for PASS doctor and the detected Node.js and Git versions.

steps.title: Install from the local guide
steps.description: Open docs/getting-started.md in your checkout. Follow the commands to preview the install, apply it and check its status. Start a new Codex session in your project and call $tangyixiao-workflow.
